name: design-slice
context_rationale: This skill asks up to 4 clarifying questions interactively when real design ambiguity exists, and its design output is anchored to the live conversation context with the user; it also calls /critique via Skill tool as auto-advance.
summary: Produces a just-enough per-slice design (design.json) by querying code-review-graph for blast-radius and reachability context, consulting the ephemeral project-frame synthesizer, identifying only what is new for this slice, asking <=4 clarifying questions when genuinely ambiguous, and tagging every new ADR with reversibility. In Heavy mode it also updates threat-model.json and cost-estimation.json. Completes by updating milestone.json and auto-advancing to /critique.

reads.purpose: Primary input: defines slice intent, ACs, verification plan, and scope.
Source for reachability, blast-radius, and shortest-path queries before designing.
Full detail from specific past reflection(s) surfaced by keyword graph query.

outputs.purpose: Primary deliverable: just-enough spec covering what's new, components touched, contracts, data model deltas, wiring matrix, ADR refs, auth model, error model.
Updated to stage=design, progress checkbox ticked, next-action set to /critique or /build-slice.
One file per decision locked by this slice, each tagged with reversibility.
Heavy mode only: update component audit artifact when the slice substantively changes a component.
Heavy mode only: update contract audit artifact when the slice substantively changes a contract.
Heavy mode only: update when the slice changes the attack surface.
Heavy mode only: update when the slice changes the infrastructure footprint.

tools.name: project_frame_synth
tools.purpose: Emit an ephemeral <=40-line project-frame (Identity / Trajectory / Impact) so the design is direction-aware before any writing begins; advisory, never a gate.

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.invocation: code-review-graph build|update | CRG MCP tools (impact-radius, review-context, search)
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — builds/refreshes the code graph; reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read mission-brief.json, existing vault context (components, decisions, prior reflections), .code-review-graph/, archived reflection.json files.

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Create design.json under <vault>/slices/slice-NNN-<name>/ and new ADR files under <vault>/decisions/.

harness_tools.name: Edit
harness_tools.purpose: Update <vault>/slices/slice-NNN-<name>/milestone.json (stage, progress checkbox, next-action, current-focus, on-resume).

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run code-review-graph queries, project_frame_synth, and optionally rebuild the code-review-graph graph.

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Ask up to 4 clarifying questions when real design ambiguity exists in the mission brief (halts auto-advance).

harness_tools.name: Grep
harness_tools.purpose: Fall back to grepping <vault>/slices/archive/ for conceptual matches when code-review-graph keyword query cannot find the literal term.

harness_tools.name: Skill
harness_tools.purpose: Auto-advance to /critique on clean completion (or self-skipping /critique routes onward if critic-required=false).

missing_references.reason: External pip package, intentionally not bundled in the plugin.
